basic_profile.bio: Hi there! I'm Alex, a college freshman from Texas studying Computer Science. I'm a huge fan of video games, especially FPS and RPGs. I've recently gotten into Paladins, and I'm still learning the ropes. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after classes and during weekends. I'm single and love hanging out with my friends to discuss game strategies or just chill. I'm not a fan of Apple products, as you might guess from my recent subreddit visits. I'm also interested in story-driven games like Tales of Arise and the Halo series.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: As a computer science student, I have a growing knowledge of programming and tech. However, I'm still a novice when it comes to Paladins and gaming strategies. I learn mostly through playing and watching online tutorials.
